Let's not fix this issue this way as it seems like some genuine problem with signals not being emitted. You are just changing the constructor to send the version as part of it which won't solve the actual version set signal emit issue. So, lets solve the actual problem.

I would suggest to start by -
1. Introspecting to find the ObjectManager instance. I see you are creating it on /. So, verify it.
2. If you do see one, then maybe run dbus-monitor --system when that interface is being created so you can see what signals are actually emitted


Looked at code and suggesting changes based on that -
1. Also change ObjectManager to be at /xyz/openbmc_project/software as thats the parent path we are interested in.
2. Change ctx.get_bus().request_name(serviceNameFull.c_str()); to ctx.request_name(...) instead.

the 'interfacesAdded' signal is emitted when using ```emit_added()``` (testing on the BMC)
but this also crashes the unit tests (testing locally)

I have commented on https://github.com/openbmc/sdbusplus/issues/86
@alexander.hansen@9elements.com Did u try the propertyName<true>(..) i mentioned to you?

That will emit 'property changed' signal, which is not what we need.

The object mapper does not react to that, it needs the 'interfaces added' signal.
@alexander.hansen@9elements.com I provided another probable solution here https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/+/78291/comment/8ca322bc_fdf44eaf/. Did you try that?

@alexander.hansen@9elements.com  Call setupBusName() here in constructor instead of initDevices and see if it fixes your signal emit issue. Since D-bus registration will happen early, the signals might start flowing fine.

Why is this change needed only for version interface? I am trying to understand how other interfaces such as Progress, Activation are working without this change?
We can go with this change until the related change is made in sdbusplus. Once sdbusplus change lands please drop this fix.

We need to set the VersionPurpose as "xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version.VersionPurpose.Host" for BIOS and not other because its supported by the DBus interface. So, lets pass this somewhere from the updater side, so it can be set accordingly in the common code.
For other types not enumerated in VersionPurpose, the Updater shall pass as "xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version.VersionPurpose.Other".
Created a default parameter for ```setVersion``` such that this change does not break the code updaters in review. VersionPurpose can be passed in now.
